hook: AI gave you a 47-step plan when you asked for help with one decision. Here's why.
caption:
AI gave you a 47-step plan when you asked for help with one decision. Here's why.

Some people think in systems. They see the whole board before they move a single piece. When they ask AI for advice, they want the framework, the dependencies, the second-order effects.

Other people think in momentum. Just tell me the next move. I'll figure out the rest when I get there.

AI doesn't know which one you are.

So it guesses. And it usually guesses wrong — giving the systems thinker a shallow 3-bullet answer, and burying the momentum thinker under a project plan they never asked for.

This isn't an AI problem. It's a calibration problem.

Your thinking style is specific. The way you process decisions, weigh risk, handle ambiguity — it's actually pretty consistent across everything you do. But every time you open a new chat, AI starts from zero.

BootFile fixes that. It builds a profile of how YOU think — not just what you do — so AI stops making you fight for responses that actually fit your brain.

Stop rewording prompts hoping for a different result.

The problem was never your prompts.
